correctness.rationale: For the fixed point of 0->01,1->00, d_i=nu_2(i+1) mod 2 and no factor 0000 occurs. For any infinite word where each L-block contains 1, equality of T-images at longer length forces equality of the T-images of its first L symbols and thereby the original words if length-L T is injective (prefix inheritance). A 10-block is determined by residues modulo 16 except for at most one multiple of 16; representing that exceptional position by 16 or 32 supplies every 10-factor in the prefix of length 42. Independent valuation-based enumeration of those complete windows found the exact (p,rho) pairs (2,2),(3,2),(5,3),(6,3),(8,5),(10,7),(11,9),(12,10),(14,13),(16,16), distinct 16 images at n=10 and the collision 000101010/010001010 at n=9. Hence injectivity at n=1 and every n>=10, not at n=2..9. Prefix experiment is finite but enumeration is exhaustive for n=10 by the residue proof; inheritance is the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The single-step tortoise operation on a canonical automatic word defines a genuine complexity invariant. A sharp stabilization threshold and every exceptional count give a natural exact classification, and the bounded-gap prefix lemma is reusable. The result is not just an old ordinary factor-complexity recurrence or an isolated table; the infinite threshold needs the symbolic-dynamics argument.

limitations: Only the binary period-doubling fixed point under one application of tortoise is covered; arbitrary automatic languages and repeated tortoise iterates are not classified.
